MORE:
The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on Thursday, the 05th day of November, 2026, inter alia, considered and approved following Agenda Items:
1. Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and Half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
2. Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors on the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
3. Reconstitution of various Committees of Board.
The Board meeting commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 04:55 P.M.
Kindly take the same on your records.

MORE:
Him Teknoforge Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve We wish to inform you that Pursuant to Regulation 29 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, (Listing Regulations), a Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 05th day
of November, 2026 to consider and approve the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026.
Further, the Trading Window in respect of dealing in Equity Shares of the Company is already closed for insider, directors, connected person, designated employees of the Company and the concern, and shall open 48 hours after conclusion of the Board Meeting.
